title: MOASYS-Vault — validation.json (movies)
description: Per-movie TMDB validation results, joinable to movies.json by (title, year, edition). One entry per scanned movie regardless of whether TMDB matched. Generated by `npm run validate:movies`.

tmdb_id.description: TMDB ID when matched, null otherwise.

tmdb_title.description: Canonical title from TMDB. May differ from your folder title in case/punctuation.

tmdb_title_filename_safe.description: TMDB title with filename-illegal characters stripped. Use as a rename target.

tmdb_year.description: TMDB's canonical release year. Often differs from your folder year by 1 (premiere vs wide release).

alternatives.description: Other candidate matches when the pick was uncertain.
